title: Gifts of the Twelfth House
text: Carts arrive at every Seat bearing gifts from the Twelfth House: fine blades, good wine, a signet for each lord. There have only ever been eleven Houses in this city, and none of them was ever numbered.

options.label: Accept the gifts with thanks. It would be rude to refuse a House, even one that does not exist.

outcomes.text: Every House is richer by a fine thing. The carts leave empty, and the drivers have no faces under their hoods.

options.label: Burn the gifts in the square, carts and all. Nothing from a Twelfth House is a gift.

outcomes.text: The blades scream in the fire. The city is poorer, and the night is very quiet.

options.label: Give it all to the Commons, unopened, and let no single House owe the Twelfth.

outcomes.text: The Commons' stores swell. In the vault, at night, the wine casks can be heard talking among themselves.
